response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM status_counts), with_share AS (SELECT sc.powerstatus, sc.count, CAST(sc.count AS FLOAT) / tc.total * 100 as share FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_share) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ws.share > av.avg_share THEN ws.count ELSE 0 END) as total_telescopes, AVG(CASE WHEN ws.share > av.avg_share THEN ws.share ELSE NULL END) as average_share, AVG(CASE WHEN ws.share > av.avg_share THEN ws.share ELSE NULL END) - av.avg_share as above_average FROM with_share ws CROSS JOIN avg_share_val av
